rubric: Direct reading of complete input and answer. Faithful means no clear material unsupported claim, actor reversal or proposal-to-agreement change. Instruction is pass/fail/borderline; pronouns and sentence limits judged directly, very short is qualitative, not the earlier arbitrary 30-word cutoff. Other errors include incomplete answers. No external fact-checking of source articles; synthetic correspondence is not presumed factual history.
